title: FDM+: A Framework for Constrained Control of the 2D Radiative Transport Equation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying the frozen diffusion model (FDM) [29] to the constrained control of the 2D radiative transport equation presents several challenges. These include the dimensional difference between control variables and state functions, the resolution mismatch between traditional numerical solvers and deep learning models, and solution non-uniqueness. To address these obstacles, we propose a novel approach, FDM+, which includes three key improvements. Firstly, a decoupled prediction architecture is introduced to address the dimensional heterogeneity. Secondly, an efficient parameterization strategy resolves the resolution mismatch. Meanwhile, we derive a total error bound to analyze how the parameterization error and the model estimation error jointly affect the performance. Thirdly, the conditional distribution learned by the diffusion model is leveraged to perform design space exploration for multi-solution problems. A series of numerical exp

translated_title: FDM+：一个用于二维辐射输运方程受限控制的框架
translated_abstract: 将冻结扩散模型（FDM）应用于二维辐射输运方程的受限控制面临诸多挑战，包括控制变量与状态函数之间的维度差异、传统数值求解器与深度学习模型之间的分辨率不匹配，以及解的非唯一性。为克服这些障碍，我们提出了一种新颖的方法FDM+，其中包含三项关键改进。首先，引入解耦预测架构以应对维度异质性问题。其次，采用高效的参数化策略解决分辨率不匹配问题；同时，我们推导了总误差界，用以分析参数化误差与模型估计误差如何共同影响性能。第三，利用扩散模型学习到的条件分布对多解问题进行设计空间探索。一系列数值实验……
tldr: 该论文提出FDM+框架，通过解耦预测架构、带总误差界分析的高效参数化策略以及基于条件分布的设计空间探索，解决了冻结扩散模型在二维辐射输运方程受限控制中维度差异、分辨率不匹配与多解性三大难题。
en_tdlr: FDM+ is a novel framework that enables constrained control of the 2D radiative transport equation with frozen diffusion models by introducing a decoupled prediction architecture, an efficient parameterization strategy with a total error bound analysis, and conditional-distribution-based design space exploration for multi-solution problems.
